primary_anchor_zh: 方脸、短卷发和青绿色工作衫
story_reason_zh: 他去棚屋取喷壶，随后回到种植台

shot_design.role_zh: 建立主体与主要视觉锚点
shot_design.outline_zh: 年轻黑人男园艺师在阳光庭院的宽叶植物旁，缓慢擦拭一片大型叶片。
shot_design.main_action_zh: 缓慢擦拭一片大型叶片
shot_design.anchor_visibility_zh: 方脸、短卷发和青绿色工作衫占据足够画面面积并清楚可见。

shot_design.outline_zh: 主体经由庭院拱门缓慢走出画面；随后呈现空园艺凳、种植台和宽叶植物。
shot_design.main_action_zh: 主体经由庭院拱门缓慢走出画面
shot_design.connection_to_story_zh: 离场动作与原有故事原因对应，动作缓慢、短距离，镜头保持固定。
shot_design.remaining_visual_zh: 空园艺凳、种植台和宽叶植物

shot_design.role_zh: 重新呈现主体并触发长期召回
shot_design.outline_zh: 主体经由庭院拱门缓慢走回画面，并停回原活动位置
shot_design.main_action_zh: 主体经由庭院拱门缓慢走回画面，并停回原活动位置
shot_design.visual_correspondence_zh: Shot 3 重新清楚展示方脸、短卷发和青绿色工作衫，并保持相近景别与主体占比。

generation_prompts.caption: A fixed medium shot frames a young Black man with a square face, short curls, and a teal work shirt beside a broad-leaf plant in a sunlit courtyard. He wipes one large leaf with a slow, careful motion. Bright courtyard light separates the teal shirt from the greenery.

A fixed medium shot shows a young Black man with a square face, short curls, and a teal work shirt walking slowly through the courtyard archway until he leaves the frame. The fixed camera then holds on the empty gardening stool, the planting table, and the broad-leaf plant. A single drop of water slides down a leaf tip.

A fixed medium shot shows a young Black man with a square face, short curls, and a teal work shirt walking slowly back through the courtyard archway and settling beside a broad-leaf plant in a sunlit courtyard.

transition_design.shot_2_exit_action_zh: 主体经由庭院拱门缓慢走出画面
transition_design.shot_2_remaining_visual_zh: 空园艺凳、种植台和宽叶植物
transition_design.shot_3_return_action_zh: 主体经由庭院拱门缓慢走回画面，并停回原活动位置
transition_design.design_note_zh: Shot 2 在固定镜头内先展示自然离场，再保留背景；Shot 3 用对应动作让主体回到画面。

duration_design.rationale_zh: Shot 1 保持 24 blocks 建立主体与视觉锚点；Shot 2 调整为 12 blocks，使主体缺席区间介于 V2 的 16 blocks 与 V3 的 8 blocks 之间；Shot 3 调整为 12 blocks，在总长 48 blocks 下形成中等记忆间隔难度。
